newsitem.title: THAILAND: Three Thai fishermen said killed by Vietnamese.
newsitem.headline: Three Thai fishermen said killed by Vietnamese.

text.p: Three Thai trawler fishermen were shot dead by Vietnamese maritime authorities on Tuesday while fishing in the Gulf of Thailand, a fishing industry official said on Wednesday.

Prateung Tipayamas, head of the fishermen's association in southern Nakhon Sri Thammarat province, told Reuters he had received the report about the killings from the fishermen's internal marine radio network.
The identity of the victims was not yet known, he said.
Vietnamese authorities shot dead the three Thai fishermen in the trawler named Mor Sintalay 3 and had detained two other trawlers Thienchai Watana and Nava 9 and their crews, he said.
Thai provincial authorities and navy officials could not be reached for comment.
Vietnam has in the past accused Thai fishermen of poaching in its waters, but the Thais have denied the charge.
